title: Tariff Schedule Dataset
description: Structured local dataset contract for offline tariff-line lookup consumed by the hs-classification-workflow skill (Execution Step 6) and downstream cost/duty analysis. Closes docs/variant-benchmark-backlog.md section 10 'No tariff-schedule dataset schema' (gap closed 2026-08-25).

jurisdiction.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 of the home jurisdiction (must match a country profile under docs/countries/)

captured_at.description: As-of date of the capture; rates older than the current tariff year must be re-captured before use

source.description: Authoritative source, e.g. 'Korea Customs Service tariff portal'

hs_code.description: 6-digit HS subheading plus optional 2+2 digits of national tariff-line depth

units.description: Statistical supplementary units, e.g. 'kg', '1000 pcs', or 'none'

specific_duty.description: e.g. 'KRW 500/kg' when the line uses specific duty

rule_ref.description: Origin-rule reference for the fta-origin-determination skill to verify

vat_note.description: e.g. 'VAT 10% on CIF + duty' when relevant
